name: Dhara Cave
description: A seam of daylight runs east along a wall that sweats. The floor is grit and old ash. Nothing here has been swept in a long time, and the things that live here have stopped expecting visitors.

pois.label: Cave mouth
pois.text: The light widens as you near it. Beyond, grass moves in a wind you cannot feel yet, and something pale is standing very still in it.

pois.label: Ring of ash
pois.text: Someone built a fire here and left before it died. The ash holds a print the size of your hand, and a second one that is not the same shape.

pois.label: Scratched wall
pois.text: Tallies cut into the stone, four and then a fifth across. They stop at thirty-one. The last cut is deeper than the rest.
